drivers.why: ITA and XAR hold defence stocks.

Saudi-led coalition says Houthis attempted to attack dozens of Saudi facilities
events.summary: The Saudi-led coalition said the Houthis attempted to attack dozens of Saudi facilities, a day after Houthi fire was intercepted over the Medina region and following the strike on Aramco's Dhahran headquarters.

events.title: Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia, setting St Petersburg oil terminal and depot ablaze
events.summary: Russia's defence ministry said it downed about 1,015 Ukrainian drones overnight, one of the largest attacks of the war; fires hit the St Petersburg oil terminal, the Ruchyi oil depot and a VK data centre, with one person killed. Russia answered with about 300 drones.

events.title: Department of War and BAE Systems sign framework to surge counter-drone production
events.summary: The US Department of War and BAE Systems signed a framework agreement to surge production of counter-drone systems.

events.title: Houthis claim strikes on Saudi Shaybah oilfield, Aramco Yanbu site and Riyadh and Abha airports
events.summary: Yemen's Houthis said they attacked Saudi energy, airport and military targets including the Shaybah oilfield, an Aramco site in Yanbu, King Khalid airport in Riyadh and Abha airport; Saudi damage was not confirmed in the report.

events.title: Poland scrambles fighter jets as Russia strikes western Ukraine
events.summary: Poland scrambled fighter jets as Russia launched strikes on western Ukraine near the Polish border, a day after Kyiv said it would resume refinery strikes.

events.title: Russian strike kills six in Kharkiv region as Zelensky says US is delaying 'vital supplies'
events.summary: Ukraine said a Russian attack killed six people at a park in the Kharkiv region, including three children; Zelensky said Russia struck without warning from partners and the US was delaying vital supplies.

events.title: Ukrainian drones hit Surgut condensate plant in Russia's largest oil-producing region
events.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack started a fire at an industrial facility in the Surgut district of Khanty-Mansi, identified by residents as Gazprom Pererabotka's Surgut Condensate Stabilization Plant, Russia's largest such facility; it appears to be the first strike on energy infrastructure in the region, and Surgut and Kogalym airports were restricted.

events.title: Ukraine runs out of Patriot interceptor missiles, CNN reports
events.summary: CNN reports Ukraine has run out of Patriot interceptor missiles as Zelensky and Trump clash over the war.

events.title: Zelensky offers to halt strikes on Russian refineries in exchange for more Patriot missiles
events.summary: Zelensky said Ukraine could stop striking Russian refineries if it received more US Patriot interceptors, calling that the minimum acceptable; Ukraine resumed refinery strikes on October 15.

events.title: Massive overnight Russian attack leaves over half a million Ukrainians without power
events.summary: Zelensky said a large overnight Russian missile and drone attack on energy infrastructure left more than 500,000 Ukrainians without electricity.

events.title: Putin suggests meeting with Trump and Xi to discuss ending the Ukraine war, report says
events.summary: Putin suggested a three-way meeting with Trump and Xi to discuss a resolution of the Ukraine war, the Jerusalem Post reported; the Kremlin earlier said such talks could happen at the APEC summit in Shenzhen on Nov 18-19.

events.title: Russian strike kills a woman and hits a Kyiv subway station, mayor says
events.summary: A Russian overnight strike on Kyiv killed a woman and damaged a metro station, the city's mayor said, Reuters reported.

events.title: IRGC says a second supertanker hit a naval mine in Hormuz and declares the strait closed
events.summary: Iran's IRGC said a second supertanker struck a naval mine on an unauthorized Strait of Hormuz route and declared the strait closed after the tanker hits; the vessels were not identified and the US says the strait is under US and partner control. The claims are unverified.

events.title: NBC: attacks on ships around the Strait of Hormuz reach record highs as Iran steps up strikes
events.summary: NBC News reported attacks on vessels around Hormuz have reached record levels with little US response; Reuters-cited tracking had already counted at least 12 tanker attacks in the week to Oct 5, the most since the war began.

events.title: UKMTO: tanker hit by unidentified projectile northeast of Saudi Arabia's Jubail
events.summary: UKMTO reported a tanker was struck by an unidentified projectile northeast of Jubail on Friday; the crew was safe and evacuated. It extends Gulf shipping attacks beyond the Strait of Hormuz into Saudi waters.

events.title: Ukraine hits Russian oil refinery as it resumes strikes; oil rises
events.summary: Russia accused Ukraine of attacking an oil refinery after Zelenskyy said strikes would resume, and Axios reported Ukraine hit a Russian refinery; WSJ said oil rose on the Russia strikes.

events.title: IRGC says a supertanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine on an 'unauthorized' Hormuz route
events.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said an oil tanker ignited after striking a naval mine while using what they called an unauthorized route through the Strait of Hormuz; the vessel was not identified and the claim was not independently verified. It follows similar IRGC claims on Oct 10 (supertanker) and Oct 14 (container ship).

events.title: Lithuania issues red air-raid alert, shuts Kaunas airport as NATO jets scramble over possible drones
events.summary: Lithuania's crisis centre issued a red air-raid alert for central and northern regions and urged residents to shelter; NATO air police were scrambled and Kaunas airport was shut. Latvia issued a yellow alert for southern regions near Lithuania over a possible drone threat.

events.title: Ukraine to resume strikes on Russian refineries, Zelenskyy tells FT
events.summary: Zelenskyy told the Financial Times Ukraine will restart strikes on Russian oil refineries after a three-day pause under Trump's 'energy ceasefire', saying Russia kept attacking Ukraine's energy system.

events.title: Norway's $2 trillion wealth fund may ease exclusion of major defence companies
events.summary: CNBC reports Norway's $2 trillion sovereign wealth fund, long barred from major defence companies, may see those ethical exclusions loosened.

episodes.lesson: A major exporter at war moves energy, food and metals at once.
Sector damage can last years; the broad market recovered in weeks.
